criteria.name: a real review wake is dispatched for the Officer (latch coordinator exists): durable wake intent row + model-visible wake turn
the human Stop writes exactly one durable latch-scoped marker at the documented path with the documented content (function `true` inferred: the only `false` path returns before any write)

a machine `team_send_message` (member.send, caller instance = Leader) does NOT clear the human Sticky Stop and does NOT re-deliver the withdrawn review wake (the message itself is still delivered by the team layer)
a machine WORK delivery (member.followup) does NOT clear the Stop and does NOT re-deliver the withdrawn review wake (the work unit is still admitted by the team layer)
the Sticky Stop marker survives SIGKILL + cold boot byte-identical and is not re-delivered at boot
after cold boot a NEW review leg for the SAME reviewer is suppressed (no new wake turn) — the recovered marker is consulted
